blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Before continue our trip, we will visit some of the highlight’s points of this beautiful city like its Historic Center, the heart of the city and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, marvel at the well-preserved colonial architecture, pastelcolored facades and narrow cobblestone streets. Visit the stunning Cathedral, an iconic landmark that showcases Spanish baroque architecture, its ornate interior and impressive façade are a testament to the city’s rich history. You will also visit some others points of interest like the Malecon and the Baluartes, a series of fortified bastions that once defended the city. We will visit Uxmal, one of the most outstanding archaeological sites in the region; this ancient Maya complex is known for its majestic architecture, ingenious design and rich history. The buildings are constructed of limestone and feature elaborate hand-carved facades that include intricate geometric designs and depictions of gods and feathered serpents.

The main landmark is the Pyramid of the Soothsayer, a stepped structure with an unusual slope and a panoramic view from its top. Afterward continuation to Merida a charming and historic city located in the Yucatán Peninsula of México known for its rich cultural heritage and colonial architecture, it offers a unique blend of Mayan and Spanish influences. The city boasts well-preserved colonial buildings, cobblestone streets and a vibrant town center. The focal point of the city is the Plaza de la Independencia, which is flanked by the fortress-like Catedral de Mérida and the white limestone Iglesia de la Tercera Orden.
